SitePartDef.label: abandoned Wraith cloning installation
SitePartDef.description: A mostly sealed Wraith population-production ruin containing dead gestation cocoons, collapsed nutrient transfer machinery and a drained donor dais. No live cloning system remains.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: A mostly sealed Wraith cloning installation lies ahead. Its gestation systems are dead, though finite biological salvage may remain and a Keeper-led reclamation party is possible.
